definition.author: gemini-antigravity
definition.scope: Coupled staggered PDAS re-equilibration execution on non-coarsened C6 mesh (15,252 CPE4 quads, 15,559 physical nodes) at target uy = 0.0018703125 mm with two-phase safeguarded relaxation: Stage 1 maintains conservative damping omega_d = 0.5 until compound active-set condition is met (|A_k| <= 500, |Delta A_k| <= 10, Delta A^+ = 0 for 3 consecutive iterations); Stage 2 activates candidate relaxation omega_d = 0.85 with automatic rollback if delta_d_{k+1} > 1.05 * delta_d_k or divergence factor > 1.5; proposed budget of 140 outer iterations; node-resolved active-set membership telemetry; preserving zero healing, signed KKT, and force/energy discrepancy <= 2.0%.
definition.scientific_hypothesis: Package 171-R7 demonstrated that uniform damping omega_d = 0.5 contracted the active set monotonically to 160 nodes, but the strict threshold (|Delta A_k| <= 2) was never activated because of persistent boundary shifting (|Delta A_k| = 4-6). Transitioning to Stage 2 with a compound trigger (|A_k| <= 500, |Delta A_k| <= 10, Delta A^+ = 0 for 3 consecutive iterations) enables relaxation acceleration while strictly preventing premature switching during expansion. With conservative contraction rate rho = 0.84, crossing delta_d <= 1e-5 requires 40 relaxation iterations after trigger at outer 89, demanding an expanded budget of 140 outer iterations (51 relaxation iterations, 11 margin iterations, projected delta_d = 1.27e-6). The projected damage convergence at iteration 140 is an unverified hypothesis, not proof of coupled convergence, and must be independently evaluated for damage, displacement, history, KKT, force/energy consistency, numerical stability, and the proposed iteration budget.

mathematical_formulation.mesh_level: C6 (15,252 CPE4 elements, 15,559 physical nodes + RP 999999, 59 duplicate seam-slit pairs)
mathematical_formulation.damping_formulation: Two-phase: Stage 1 omega_d = 0.5; Stage 2 candidate omega_d = 0.85 activated upon compound active-set condition (|A_k| <= 500, |Delta A_k| <= 10, Delta A^+ = 0 sustained for 3 consecutive iterations)
mathematical_formulation.rollback_criterion: If delta_d_{k+1} > 1.05 * delta_d_k or divergence factor > 1.5 in Stage 2, trial update is reverted to omega_d = 0.5 state and Stage 1 resumes
mathematical_formulation.membership_telemetry: Explicit node-resolved active-set symmetric difference |Delta A_k| = |A_k \ A_{k-1}| + |A_{k-1} \ A_k| and added nodes Delta A^+ = |A_k \ A_{k-1}| recorded in telemetry, distinct from scalar cardinalities |A_k|
mathematical_formulation.kkt_evaluation: Explicit post-relaxation KKT stationarity recomputation: solver.kkt(d^{k+1}, tau_active=1e-6, tau_free=1e-6) evaluated under corresponding H^{k+1}
mathematical_formulation.coupled_field_consistency: Final mechanical subproblem resolution on converged damage state to ensure u, d, H, RF, and energies refer to a mutually equilibrated state with delta_u <= 1e-9 mm and delta_H <= 1e-4 MPa
mathematical_formulation.phase_decoding: Strict fail-closed validation of exactly 15,559 unique physical-node records. Only documented 1-component damage or >=3-component U with damage in U3 accepted; 2-component (U1, U2), mixed counts, missing nodes, duplicate nodes, and nonfinite values rejected before clipping to d0
mathematical_formulation.obstacle_enforcement: Pointwise active-set Dirichlet clamp prescribed = {n: d0[n] for n in active} ensuring min(d - d0) >= -1.0e-6

definition.source_differences: Package 171-R8 introduces compound active-set transition criteria and recalibrated iteration budgeting: (1) Replaces the overly restrictive R7 transition criterion (|Delta A_k| <= 2) with a compound active-set criterion: |A_k| <= 500, |Delta A_k| <= 10, and zero newly activated nodes (Delta A^+ = 0) sustained for 3 consecutive iterations; (2) Expands outer iteration budget from 100 to 140 iterations, providing 51 relaxation iterations after simulated trigger at outer 89, which projects crossing delta_d <= 1e-5 (projected delta_d = 1.27e-6) with 11 margin iterations, whereas 120 iterations left only 31 relaxation iterations and failed with projected delta_d = 4.15e-5; (3) Preserves two-tier safeguards: 5% residual growth rollback (delta_d_{k+1} > 1.05 * delta_d_k) and divergence factor safeguard (gamma = 1.5 over 2 consecutive iterations) reverting to Stage 1; (4) Strictly maintains zero healing tolerance (1.0e-6), signed KKT stationarity (< 1.0e-6), GP history loading (61,008 points), element-level SOLUTION serialization, and force/energy continuity <= 2.0%; (5) Preserves unchanged frozen production UEL CE8D5EDCD2911DCB018BB15275271F874E7EA62B8FB48CF4A8297469A83ACDD6.
execution_prerequisites: Independent technical review and signed approval
Real Abaqus 2023 datachecks Exit 0 for mechanical and phase input decks
Dual-channel notification end-to-end delivery verified (Telegram + PBS mail)
Strictly 1 PBS job submission on single-rank serial 1 CPU, 16 GB, 8 h
